name: stocksense
description: StockSense — modular, real-time Inventory Management System (MERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,server,client -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
